fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-07-22, the complainant bought a blue car bearing registration number TN-28-YY-1076 for Rs. 2,50,000 and later found that the documents shown by the seller were doubtful. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-07-19 at approximately 17:10. Ganesh Natarajan reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000055. Yuvaraj Selvam was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Prakash may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000017. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100077 as the destination of the transfer.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared doubtful papers and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: vehicle sale, cheating, mobile number, receiving account, evening, car, suspect, main street
